turns.prompt_text: show me the dolphin Nautilus CC Pro
turns.response_html: The Dolphin Nautilus CC Pro is a robotic pool cleaner with Wi-Fi connectivity, controlled via the MyDolphin Plus app. It is designed for in-ground pools up to 50 feet and cleans the floor, walls, and waterline. It features two scrubbing brushes, an anti-tangle swivel, and a top-loading filter basket. It has a 2-year warranty and a weekly timer function, but lacks advanced features like multiple filter options or a full-filter indicator.
